tasks.prompt: Using git from the shell in this repository, what are the short hash and the subject of the 25th most recent commit (HEAD counts as the 1st)? Read-only, do not modify anything.
Look at the full diff between HEAD~3 and HEAD in this repository (use git diff in the shell). List EVERY file that changed and summarise in one line what changed in each file. Read-only.

Run the Go tests of ./internal/budget/ and ./internal/goal/ with `go test` in the shell and tell me exactly how many top-level test functions passed and how many failed in total. Do not modify any file.
How many pods exist in total across all namespaces of the cluster, and are any pods NOT in Running or Completed state? Use kubectl (current context). Read-only: do not change anything in the cluster.
What are the allocatable memory and the kernel version of node node3? Use kubectl (current context). Read-only: do not change anything in the cluster.
Run this Go package's tests with `go test` in the shell. Which test fails, at which file:line, and what is the root cause in the code? Read-only: do not modify any file.
Run `cargo test` in this Rust crate. Which test fails and what are the left and right values of the failing assertion? Read-only: do not modify any file.
Using npm in the shell, list the packages installed at the top level of this Node project with their exact installed versions. Read-only: do not modify any file.

Using the pip of the virtualenv in ./venv (venv/bin/pip), list every package installed in it with its version, and tell me which version of requests and of urllib3 is installed. Read-only: do not modify any file.
